_comment: Every tunable number and rule used by the pipeline. The text is Miqra according to the Masorah (src/textsource_mam.py); seder and ʿăliyya boundaries come from the site's EY table (../ey_table.py).
_break_kind_precedence_comment: A break after verse v is classified by the FIRST rule that applies: v carries a petuha mark; v carries a setuma mark; the next verse is an ʿăliyya start (not the seder's first ʿăliyya); v is the last verse of its chapter; otherwise 'verse' (mid-paragraph). The break after a seder's last verse is 'seder end' and costs nothing.
_break_costs_comment: Cost of one break = break_costs[kind] * T * T, where T = seder words / days_per_seder (the seder's own daily target). Total cost of a split = sum over days of (day words - T)^2 + sum of break costs. The split minimizing total cost wins; ties go to the earliest break (strict < in the dynamic program).

constraints._comment: Books never cross because each book ends a seder. No global daily target: each seder is balanced against its own T, so week-to-week length follows the sedarim.

review._comment: Rules used on 2026-11-07 to pick sedarim for hand review and to generate the alternatives shown.

xlsx._comment: Thresholds used in the Stats sheet formulas.
